modifications: The same Tripo Triceratops and bake as the game (dist/assets/dinosaurs/triceratops-source.json), with three remake changes: the parts are welded into one closed skin rendered single-sided, the finished Mosi is scaled uniformly to his real adult length of 8.5 m from nose to tail tip (one scale of 2.112 on the root node; skin, skeleton and clips grow together), and a clip only the remake uses, tailDown (the bake adds it with clips=remake).

walk.note: The test scene walks him at 0.95 m/s, so the clip plays at about 0.77x: big animals step slower.

tailDown.note: Chapter 1, scene 5: the remake plays it once and holds the last frame (actor.play('tailDown', { once: true })). Tail1 to Tail5 turn down about his right side until the tail runs straight from Tail1, 40.6 degrees below the horizontal, with its tip on the ground 3.3 m behind the hind feet, for Egill to climb (remake/engine/riding.js). The top of the tail rises at 42 to 64 degrees.
